snippet.title: Sonic Rumble – Global Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Ready, Set, Rumble! The wait is over – Sonic Rumble is live worldwide on iOS, Android, and Steam 🌍

Join Sonic in this intense arcade royale game set in Dr. Eggman's diabolical Toy World. Collect legendary skins, all-new emotes, and build skills as you progress through this action-packed game!

🔗 Get into the mayhem: https://sonicrumble.com/playnow

🌟 Gotta subscribe and hit that bell to never miss a beat: https://www.youtube.com/@sonic_rumble_party?sub_confirmation=1

Can you keep up? 🦔🌀 follow us:
https://www.twitter.com/sonic_rumble
https://www.tiktok.com/@sonic_rumble
https://www.instagram.com/sonic_rumble
https://www.facebook.com/SonicRumble

💬 Join the community on the Sonic Rumble Discord server! Team up, chat, and find your crew: https://discord.gg/sonicrumble

#sonicrumble #sonicthehedgehog #readysetrumble
